Weaver corner

Demo for association members. This shows how weavers could add products and post updates or issues. In this prototype, anything you add is saved only on this device and is not shown to other visitors. A real version needs a shared login and database.

Handwoven in Ibaan, Batangas.

Products from our weavers

Choose a piece and place an order. The site handler confirms each order with the weavers, including availability, price, materials and weaving time. This prototype has no order system connected yet and collects no payment, and the availability labels are samples. Because the weavers work with limited time and equipment, replies and weaving can take longer.

Design your own

Pick a product, a pattern and two colors (a main color and a pairing color) to preview your idea. Press Copy my order to get a ready-to-paste summary for the shared order list kept by the site handler. This is only a mockup: the weavers confirm what they can make and the price.
